text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Most political parties in Macedonia support the government's idea to send Macedonian soldiers as part of the multi-national military action in Albania.
- Macedonian National Bank to submit annual report for 1996 to the Macedonian parliament.
- Macedonian Defence Minister Blagoja Handziski to visit the United States on Tuesday at the invitation of U.S. Defence Secretary William Coen and discuss cooperation between the two armies.

- A delegation of Greek experts to visit Macedonian interior ministry on April 18 to discuss cooperation in fighting organised crime, illegal trade in drugs, weapons and radioactive materials. -- Skopje newsroom +389 91 201-196
